reviews.text: Very knowledgeable and kind people. I just had my elderly collie groomed and was very satisfied. Highly recommended. Thank you, ladies.
I brought my cat. It was our first time. We had a great time. The cleaning was done with love, the staff were extremely kind, and the advice was excellent. We'll definitely be back.

A truly positive first experience!
Martina is very good and immediately put my 10-year-old dog at ease. She left the grooming session feeling calm and not at all stressed, which unfortunately often happens. I'm very satisfied with the treatment she received. Highly recommended! 🙂
Seeing my puppy leave the groomer feeling happy and with a flawless cut is priceless! Thanks again for your kindness and professionalism.

One star is even too much. They cut my dog's nails so short that three of them bled, even though they were clearly told not to cut them at the appointment because they were already short. Furthermore, a few days after the appointment, I called for an explanation and was told "it's not my fault."
So, in short, rude and unprofessional staff. They don't take responsibility for what they do.
First time I take Otto to wash.. I have to say I will be back.. I really liked the service offered.. Otto was happier than me..

I'm very satisfied with Luna's grooming. She had a lot of tangles and long hair, and Martina did a fantastic job at grooming her, making her very clean and beautiful, and trimming her fur beautifully. Highly recommended!
Excellent service! She was very sweet and gentle with my dog, as well as punctual and professional. The result was perfect and the price was absolutely fair. Highly recommended!

Martina groomed my 11-year-old toy poodle, who's a bit rebellious :)) She was incredibly sweet and gentle, trying to do it as carefully and precisely as possible.
I'll definitely be back because I sensed her sincere love for animals.
Thank you
I had my dog's teeth cleaned, the result was wonderful.

A valuable resource for anyone who owns a dog. Especially for dental hygiene, it's an excellent alternative to scaling! Lower cost, no risk (general anesthesia is very dangerous, especially for older dogs).
Kind, competent, and empathetic. Our cat, who was at his first grooming session, had a great time. Thank you, we will definitely be back.

Fantastic service! Gin came out transformed: super soft fur, beautifully scented, and meticulously cared for. The wash and cut were truly done with care and attention. When you see your dog clean, relaxed, and happy, you know he's been treated well. Highly recommended! ✨🐶 …

This is the second time I've taken my Maltese, Dilan, to this grooming salon, and I can say with certainty that we had a truly wonderful experience.

The girls are excellent, extremely passionate, and you can clearly see their love for animals. They don't just work here: they're also involved in activities like dog daycare and collaborations with shelters, and this really makes a difference to me. I think they're exactly the kind of people who should work with animals: they have passion, love, and genuine dedication. You can tell they don't just do it for work, but because they truly care about the animals' well-being.

My dog ​​is 9 years old and has always been quite traumatized when I took him for a bath and a clipper. This time, however, in addition to the bath and clipper, we also had his teeth cleaned with an ultrasound, and already after the second visit, I saw him much more relaxed and at ease.

I highly recommend this place and these wonderful girls. I feel great and am truly satisfied.

Thank you so much for your professionalism and dedication!
Kind and professional

A truly positive experience.
Leda felt at ease; aside from the very first contact with the chain collar, which reminded her of the kennel, she wasn't scared at all.
She was thoroughly washed, dried, and groomed thanks to Martina's wonderful manners!
I've already spread the word 🤩
Martina is very good, but what really impressed me was how clean the place was; there wasn't a hair on the floor. Top!

This was my first time trying Pet Glow for my dog ​​Amy.
From the appointment onwards, I could feel how much they cared.
The service was 10/10, my dog ​​came out smelling amazing.

An aesthetic paradise for my dogs, they really make them shine!
Professionalism and love 😍
Highly recommended! …
RECOMMENDED! …or rather… Highly recommended for anyone looking for a high-quality grooming service, done well, at the right price, and with a true passion for furry friends!

I brought my two Akitas, a normal-haired male and a long-haired female, and despite the unique personalities of my "babies," we hit it off almost immediately. The grooming for him and the de-shedding for her were impeccably done, but most importantly, upon collection, the dogs weren't agitated or scared; on the contrary, they were calm, relaxed, and happy. Professionalism, courtesy, and lots of attention to my pets. Definitely recommended! 🐾
I brought my British longhair cat, who was first groomed and then bathed. It was a great experience, and Martina was truly loving. I highly recommend it.
PERFECTION DOESN'T EXIST BUT... Very competent staff; friendly with humans and affectionate with pets, for them it's not just a job but a love for animals.
I brought my Sugar for the first time with very knotty fur. Excellent work. She's also very good at managing the dog's temperament, which is very sensitive. ❤️
We brought our two cats, super positive experience, very kind and professional

I've taken my cat to the grooming salon twice now. I had a great experience, and my cat loved both the girls and the place. The prices are very fair, and you can tell by the way the girls work that they love animals. Highly recommended!
The first time I came here, my dog ​​had just arrived from the shelter and was terrified. She was reassured, cuddled, and made as comfortable as possible. She left happy, clean, and smelling great!
First time we bring blueberries and I have to say it was a really positive experience... the girl who runs the shop is really smart... competent and capable.
I took my puppy for her first bath and Marty treated her like a real princess! She has a really sweet touch and really knows how to handle puppies ❤️

I've brought my dog ​​here more than once and have always had a great experience. The woman is really good, friendly, and nice; she immediately puts both owners and pets at ease. She also gave me lots of helpful tips for grooming and keeping my pet happy. Highly recommended! 🐾✨ …
We had a great time, Sunny was pampered and the end result was a cloud to caress!
Very good... She takes care of every detail of our dog Ciappy without ever overlooking anything. The best grooming we've found in many years 🐶🐾 …
I took my 48 kg Amstaff to the groomer. The service was thorough and attentive. My dog ​​received lots of attention and left smelling good and stress-free. Thank you. We'll see you again soon.
The staff were incredibly helpful and knowledgeable, making our two dogs feel at ease. We'll definitely be back!

Lots of care and attention to the needs of a senior dog who isn't the easiest to groom.

Beautiful, spacious, clean, and bright environment. Pleasant and reassuring for slightly anxious dogs like Artù.
Modern and functional equipment.
Everyone is very kind and professional.
See you soon!
Thanks from Allegra and Artù

I had never taken my dog ​​to a groomer before because I have a very particular dog. However, I decided to try this place and I was thrilled! Even though my dog ​​is very wary, doesn't like water, and hates baths, they manage him with great professionalism and a lot of care. The result is always fantastic: my dog ​​comes out spotless and smells good. The girls are very sweet and kind and have always been very attentive in handling Whisky and reassuring me about bath time, which is always an unpleasant experience for him 😂. They also respond promptly on WhatsApp and know how to find the right solution for everyone, even based on their schedules. The environment is impeccable, welcoming, and well-kept. The girls are really good, and since then, I've become a regular customer. I highly recommend this groomer! 🐾💖
Very delicate, precise and super helpful. Highly recommended.
Well done! Highly recommended ☺️
Friendly staff who respect the animal's character and timing
Competent, fast, meticulous and very sweet
Martina was fantastic, I was able to stay inside while my dog ​​was groomed... super positive experience for me and my Thekla ❤️

I took my 5-month-old Persian kitten to the groomer for his first bath, and I had a really good experience.
The woman was very kind, helpful, and patient, especially considering that the cat was initially a bit nervous and scared of the new experience.

She treated him gently, respecting his pace, speaking calmly, and always trying to reassure him. The end result is excellent: clean, soft, and fragrant fur, with no signs of stress upon returning home.

I absolutely recommend this groomer, especially for those with cats who are new to bathing.
Great experience, stripping must be done in a certain way and here we found professionals.

Fantastic experience! The girls were super professional and kind. They carefully listened to all my requests, and the result far exceeded my expectations. My dog ​​came out calm and happy, without any signs of stress, and perfectly groomed. You can tell they truly love animals and know how to make them feel at ease.
I absolutely recommend this place, we'll definitely be back! 🐶💖
Thank you so much for taking care of my dog with love, she is even more beautiful than ever. 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏 …
Comfortable and welcoming facility. Qualified and knowledgeable staff. My big dog really enjoyed both the wash and grooming. Also recommended for large breed dogs.
The perfect team, the puppies are always well received, with affection. Then the center is all well taken care of. Top of the Top, well done

Yesterday I took my cat to the groomer; she had some serious knots. Martina and Michael welcomed us with kindness and great professionalism. We entrusted her to them, and when we returned, our cat was calm and at ease. They did an excellent job, giving us valuable advice on how to proceed. From now on, we'll always go to them.
Thank you, I recommend everyone to visit them.

It's my first time here, and it's the first time in eight years that I've decided to bring my dog ​​to get a trim and a bath, something I usually do at home. We had a great time; the lady welcomed us and met our needs, and above all, she was very sweet and professional. We'll definitely be back!
Martina is patient, knowledgeable, and above all, very friendly. She treated my two babies in the best way. Highly recommended.
It was our first time at this center. The experience was fantastic and we will definitely be back. They were attentive, kind, and did an excellent job.
Friendly and super professional staff... now a guarantee for my dachshund
I brought Bea, my Gordon Setter, and the experience was incredibly positive. Attentive, affectionate, and professional. It'll become our new home!

I'd like to commend PetGlow's professionalism and helpfulness.
My bichon frise has a much cuter face since we met PerGlow.
We brought our Lagotto and the girls who looked after him were very nice and kind and did a good job even though our Otto is a bit rebellious towards showers and clippings.

I'm really happy with the grooming service provided by Pet Glow! Kevin came home clean, smelling great, and looking great. The staff was very kind and professional, and always took my dog's specific needs into account. I highly recommend this groomer to all dog owners!
Professionalism and kindness!!! Thank you so much
This is the second time we bring Olivier (Lagotto Romagnolo) here, today at the new address, the groomer is very nice, competent and helpful, I highly recommend it
A super modern place, helpful and professional, kind and friendly! Highly recommended ☺️
Great experience, really good and very attentive to my dog's needs. Highly recommended.

We took our Siberian cat to the groomer last week. Martina was excellent, taking great care of her, trying to calm her down and respecting her schedule! The result was fabulous: her coat was even shinier, free of tangles (and without having to clip her), and she smelled great! Excellent service and value for money! We'll definitely be back :)
They are very skilled at grooming and treating our four-legged friends. They do not perform grooming for competitions or shows.
Excellent experience. My dog ​​is very timid, but she was still washed and dried with great patience and care. The haircut was perfect, too.
Excellent!!! What can I say? Well done, very kind advice 👍 …
Martina is super, attentive, and knowledgeable. Aladino thanks you.

I took my dog ​​to get washed for the first time at this place, having heard about it through word of mouth. I had a great experience, and so did my pongo, which now looks as good as new. Highly recommended!
Great experience! Martina is extremely knowledgeable and professional. Her expertise and attention to detail are truly rare, especially in Milan, based on my experience. Highly recommended!
Total satisfaction. Empathy, professionalism, love for her work and animals. Unfortunately, I don't remember your name... But I can only say THANK YOU AND SEE YOU SOON 😘😘😘 …
Precision and punctuality, the haircut for our little poodle was very much appreciated, as requested.

Would definitely recommend! They did an excellent job on my long haired cat, Mana. She smelled wonderful and looked even better. You could even tell she felt great. Will be using them again for all her grooming needs. Thank you!
I took a Husky during the shedding phase and I had a great time!

I highly recommend Pet Glow Martina, who is very professional and an animal lover.

Great experience, I'll definitely be back!
Highly recommended! Our cat isn't used to being bathed, but the welcome and kindness won out. Excellent experience. We'll be back!
This is our go-to place for grooming our dog. We've always had a great experience!

Fantastic experience! I took my puppy for his first grooming and I couldn't have asked for anything better. Martina is incredibly sweet; she welcomed my little dog with such patience and care, immediately putting him at ease. It's clear how much she loves her job: she carefully listens to both the dog's and the client's needs, carefully explaining each step. The result was perfect, and my puppy was calm and happy even after the treatment. We'll definitely be back!

For the first time, I took my 4-month-old puppy for a bath.
The experience was incredibly pleasant.
Giulio was pampered and cared for down to the smallest details. 🥰😍♥️ I highly recommend it. …

It was my first time with them. I'd been chasing them for a while, but due to shift work, I never managed to catch them.
My Yorkie was very happy, aside from the haircut and bath, which were fine. When I went to pick her up, she was nervous (obviously because she saw me), but as soon as we left, she was very calm. Unfortunately, in other places, I've had her come home with her tail and ears down.
The staff were very kind and friendly, and the price was more than fair.
Brave and patient, especially with my crazy Havana, a Lagotto who hates grooming. I highly recommend her.

I took my poodle to this grooming shop and couldn't be more pleased with the service I received! The staff was extremely kind, professional, and attentive. They treated my dog ​​with great care and attention, taking all the time necessary to ensure a thorough job. The result was impeccable: clean, smelling good, and with a perfect cut that highlighted her sweetness. You can tell they truly love animals and are passionate about their work. We'll definitely be back! Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and love for their four-legged friends.

Positive experience with the cat, not an easy one.
Very professional guys and a humane environment.

I go to Petglow because overall is a good place, its nearby my house, price and service is good and most importantly they treat dogs with care. I have taken Chanel for a year and it has always been good.
It's so true that your pet shines. Expertise, professionalism, kindness, and attention to your furry friend's needs. Tommaso is gorgeous now. I highly recommend him.
Fantastic and incredibly patient with my puppy....❤️
Experience, availability, and patience, as well as professionalism, make Martina truly special. Thank you so much, little one. Rino thanks.

I had a great experience, excellent work.
My cat was treated very well and even relaxed.

Super good! Very kind and competent,
I recommend them ;)
Perfect experience. The operator is really attentive, good, and competent. The cat immediately felt at ease and by the end he was so beautiful and clean that I almost didn't recognize him 😂 …
Very hospitable place❤️Martina very good and patient the Top❤️I'm really happy to have found this place for my Whisky😍 …

Martina is a genuine girl and a true animal lover.
A job well done. I will definitely be back!
Highly recommended.
These people deserve so much.
Highly recommended!!

Martina gently brushed my Minou, who was at her first grooming experience. She finished with a dry shampoo that left her smelling wonderful. I highly recommend this place; the animals are pampered from the first second to the last.

Courtesy, kindness, and above all, excellent work on our Emily. We were very satisfied.
Even though Emily was a little anxious, Martina knew exactly how to make her feel at ease. We'll definitely be back 👌 …
Excellent service, Martina is very knowledgeable and has a great empathy for our furry friends. I highly recommend her. The shop also smells great and is well-kept!

I brought my cat in with me, who had some fur balls on his tail and body.
They were gently removed. My cat's fur is beautiful again! Highly recommended!

Excellent experience. Excellent communication and professionalism. I've used you twice now and am always satisfied with your skill and patience with my Mambo, who is always nervous and fearful. I'll definitely be back!
Excellent, he is a very skilled professional with animals. I highly recommend him.

I brought them Satan, and he came out a Saint. Martina has infinite patience. I have a difficult Malamute, but they were incredible and made her look gorgeous for the Christmas holidays!
Well done, professional and cheerful!
Highly recommended!
See you soon!
I had a great time! The girl was super helpful and very kind! I recommend her.

Very welcoming place, very good and efficient woman, sensitive and fair with dogs.
I brought my dog ​​and called the same day, but she still found me a spot. My dog, even though he doesn't like grooming, was treated very well and was scolded with simple "no"s at the right times.
Excellent place, I recommend it.

First grooming experience. Professional service and maximum care for your dog.
Approved!
Good and kind, they treated my Dick really well. Groomed as I requested, and smelling like a gentleman. Average prices, wonderful service.
Martina is very attentive and kind and groomed my dog ​​very well.
Good and nice girl, she treated my Gipsy well even if he was nervous

I recommend her to everyone! Aside from her undeniable technical skill, Marika was able to respect our dog's emotions, and for the first time, he didn't experience stress during grooming. We'll definitely be back!
The owner is very welcoming and kind, particularly attentive to the animal and very affectionate. Arturo was thoroughly washed and checked over.
Congratulations to Martina, she was brilliant! We'll be happy to come back! Well done guys!

Martina took care of my big dog, she was super attentive and sweet.
Atma had dermatitis, and with love, care, and the right treatments, she improved within two days.
The best grooming shop I've ever been to.
I highly recommend it.
Thank you, Martina ❤️
